T:P1.4.text: Carlisle Companies Incorporated is a leading supplier of innovative Building Envelope products and solutions for more energy efficient buildings. Through its building products businesses – Construction Materials (CCM) and Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT) – and family of leading brands, Carlisle delivers innovative, labor-reducing and environmentally responsible products and solutions to customers through the Carlisle Experience.

T:P1.5.text: Carlisle recently published its 2025 Corporate Sustainability Report, showcasing continued progress against its three-pillar sustainability strategy of manufacturing energy efficient products, reducing emissions, and diverting landfill waste.

T:P2.2.text: Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM) is a leading manufacturer and supplier of a complete line of premium single-ply roofing products and warranted systems and accessories for the commercial building industry, including polyiso insulation and engineered metal roofing and panel systems. This segment markets its products primarily under the Carlisle SynTec, Versico Roofing, WeatherBond Roofing, Hunter Panels, CCM Europe, Drexel Metals and PAC-CLAD Petersen brands.

T:P2.3.text: Carlisle Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT) is a leading supplier of integrated building envelope solutions that ensure superior building performance across both commercial and residential applications. From the tallest commercial skyscrapers to residential properties of all sizes, CWT’s advanced weatherproofing systems manage the critical flow of water, vapor, air, and energy, providing cost-effective, sustainable, and reliable solutions for buildings worldwide. Our family of trusted, leading-edge building products and solutions includes Henry ®, Insulfoam ®, Carlisle Spray Foam Insulation, and Carlisle HVAC Brands.

T:P3.1.text: Carlisle Companies Incorporated - Who We Are - Acquisitions

C:P1.2.text: Solutions that Build, Feed, and Power the World

C:P1.3.text: Our innovative solutions drive critical industries forward, ensuring sustainable growth and development globally.

C:P1.4.text: Improving the quality of life for current and future generations by creating and delivering a variety of essential products across the industrial and agricultural end markets is nothing new for the people of LSB Industries, Inc. (LSB). But it doesn’t end there. We are committed to playing a leadership role in the production of low and no carbon products that not only build and feed the world, but power it, as well.

C:P1.5.text: Whether you’re a customer, a job seeker, an investor or are simply interested in our efforts to help decarbonize our world, we’re confident you will find what you are seeking at LSB.

C:P1.6.text: At LSB, our vision is to be a leader in the production of low and no carbon products that build, feed and power the world.

C:P1.7.text: We believe there is a substantial need for low carbon energy sources across various business sectors, and we are committed to helping meet that demand through the production and delivery of low and no carbon products to multiple end markets.

C:P1.8.text: LSB supplies industrial and high purity metallurgical grade ammonia and nitric acid for many specialty applications. Our knowledge, expertise, and supply position in the nitrogen products we market, when combined with our logistical advantages, provide us with the capability to offer significant value to our customers.

C:P1.9.text: Our fertilizer products – ammonia and derivative products – are used as nitrogen fertilizers that enable farmers to grow with efficacy, effectiveness, and efficiency.

C:P2.2.text: and headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, LSB manufactures ammonia and ammonia-related products at our facilities in El Dorado, Arkansas, Cherokee, Alabama, and Pryor, Oklahoma. We also operate a facility for Covestro LLC in Baytown, Texas. We are a vital supplier to the world’s leading chemical and industrial companies and to the U.S. agricultural market. The chemicals we manufacture are included in hundreds of products used by thousands of people every day.

C:P2.3.text: LSB is committed to playing a leadership role in the production of low and no carbon products that build, feed and power the world. Our team is dedicated to building a culture of excellence in customer experiences as we deliver essential products across the industrial and agricultural end markets and, coming soon, the energy markets.

C:P3.2.text: At LSB, we leverage multiple competitive advantages to provide our customers with the products they need, while ensuring they receive the best value for their investment. Our manufacturing facilities are strategically located in close proximity to key user end markets with multiple transportation options to ensure timely delivery to our customers. Our energetic Commercial and Sales teams are dedicated to meeting our customers’ needs with quality products, security of supply and superior customer service.
